# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| risk-reading | `assets/risk-reading.md`, filled | OD lead (owns five of the six risks), DBVE (owns the value risk) | All six risks have indicator value, source, read date, trigger and a status (triggered, on watch, clear or unreadable) with one-sentence evidence; Register `last-verified` date noted, with a warning if older than the month |
| triggers-hit-and-routing | Triggers section of the risk reading | `dept-decision-rights`, OD lead or the deciding role per the current approval policy, COP for technical items, for decisions outside OD | Each triggered risk has its owner, forum and the countermeasure already in the register; Any new countermeasure marked as a proposal |
| unreadable-indicators | Statuses in the reading | OD lead | Each unreadable indicator is reported as a finding with the missing source or the undefined parameter named; A risk unreadable three months running has a proposed register change |
| retro-input | The reading itself | `dept-retro` | Reading available for the month's retro; A trigger hit two months running flagged as a candidate for the one adjustment |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| risk-reading | structure of `assets/risk-reading.md` | OD lead (owns five of the six risks) |
| triggers-hit-and-routing | manual | OD lead or the deciding role per the current approval policy |
| unreadable-indicators | manual | OD lead |
| retro-input | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `metrics-scorecard`, `bc-portfolio`, `deploy-cybersec`, `invest-screen`
- **Next:** dept-retro (monthly input), dept-decision-rights for triggers outside OD, the OD lead and COP for the rest.: `dept-retro`, `dept-decision-rights`
- **Next:** Other skills (deploy-migration, dept-plant-diagnosis, deploy-project-order) hand open risks to it.: `deploy-migration`, `dept-plant-diagnosis`, `deploy-project-order`
- **Stops here when:** an indicator has no source or its trigger parameter is ⟨n⟩
- **Stops here when:** Report it as unreadable, never as clear
- **Stops here when:** Knowledge base aggregates are not readings, and no risk is added to the register by this skill
